title: Seal-Gravel Prowler
text: Seal-Gravel Prowler bursts from burial scree and drives prey toward the oldest locked doors. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The gravel moves once. Then it breathes.

defeatReward.text: Seal-Gravel Prowler is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
